newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SINGAPORE BUNKER FINAL REPORT AND PRICES - AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: SINGAPORE BUNKER FINAL REPORT AND PRICES - AUG 13.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - The Singapore bunker market rose amid firmer cargo prices and rising swaps. Sellers said prompt supplies remained tight and product for delivery over the next few days was still commanding a hefty premium. Some suppliers were sold out for product for lifting up to seven days forward. Bunker 380-cst lots were sold at $107.00 and $106.00 per tonne and 180-cst at $110.50. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870-3093)
